main_measure.name: mean excess forward 10-bar return on positioned non-overlapping blocks (vs coin's window mean over all bars)

statistic.name: one-sample t of the mean excess

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and hit-rate difference > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; inconclusive otherwise or if < 100 positioned blocks pooled or < 10 per coin

supporting_check.name: hit-rate difference (positioned blocks minus all blocks); slope of forward return on forecast reported

decided_by: The mean excess forward return is below 0 with t <= -2.
reading: Blocks are the bars at positions 0, 10, 20, ... of each window with forecast > 0; the coin's mean is taken over every bar of the window with a valid forward return; the hit rate across all blocks uses the same grid; the slope is reported but only the hit-rate difference enters the confirm rule, as the plan writes; the per-coin minimum applies to every coin present in the record.
